title: AgentPack Registry Event (v1)
description: A single agent-pack registry event, serialized as one JSON object per line in the pack registry's append-only log (registry/packs, issue #40). The event enum is closed; the status vocabulary per kind is documented in registry/packs/README.md. Record shape consumed from the CMR registry events.schema.json (ts/event/module/version/consumer/status) plus the repo's own hash-chained append-only audit log (registry/events, issue #10): seq/prevHash/hash.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence; 1, 2, 3, ... with no gaps or duplicates.

event.description: Closed pack registry event kind. plan = a pack version entered the registry; publish/pause/resume/retire = lifecycle transitions; install/upgrade/rollback = tenant install path; drift = installed-content drift detected; consume = catalog consumption recorded.

status.description: Outcome/state per kind. Conventional values: plan->planned; publish->live; pause->paused; resume->live; retire->retired; install->installed|failed; upgrade->upgraded|failed; rollback->rolled_back; drift->detected; consume->consumed.

version.description: Pack version the event concerns; null for pack-level lifecycle events without a specific version.

tenantId.description: Tenant for install/upgrade/rollback/consume events; null for pack-level lifecycle events.

actor.description: Optional principal that caused the event.

detail.description: Per-kind payload (e.g. {from, to, reason} for rollback).

prevHash.description: Hash of the previous record (all-zero genesis hash for seq 1).

hash.description: sha256 over the record's canonical JSON, hash field excluded.
